summary: Backend testing for the new /api/inspections/* module (replaces /api/points/*). Created /app/backend/tests/test_inspections.py with 18 tests across 9 test classes covering: types metadata, settings auto-create + validation, per-cadet score upserts with absent handling (knowledge Day 2 Alpha 8/9+8/9+absent), flight-level upserts (drill 51/54 = 0.9444), idempotent replace, GET filters, DELETE, merit points CRUD, dashboard aggregation (CTF avg/pts, CTS, Weekly Totals, Weekly Change Day-1 baseline, include_merit_points toggle), student summary, RBAC (regular cadre 403 with correct message, exec_cadre & commander 200, code-level check that EXEC_CADRE/EXECUTIVE_STAFF/PLANS_PROGRAMS/COMMANDER/DCP are in INSPECTION_ROLES), legacy /api/points/* returning 404, and /api/parent/my-cadet/points not 500'ing with zero data. All 18/18 passed against the public preview URL in 9.7s.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/inspections/settings validation cleanly drops invalid days/types/weight keys (verified). Behaviour: silently strips bad input — fine for an admin UI but a stricter implementation would 400 on bogus inspection types. Low priority.

Dashboard aggregation matches spec exactly: when an inspection has no data, it's excluded from CTF average (not counted as 0). Absent cadets store percent=null and are excluded from flight avg. Verified mathematically with Day 2 Alpha knowledge=8/9 (88.89%) and drill=51/54 (94.44%) producing CTF avg ~91.67% and CTF pts ~183.33.

Code-level RBAC check confirms INSPECTION_ROLES = {EXEC_CADRE, EXECUTIVE_STAFF, PLANS_PROGRAMS, COMMANDER, DCP}. testcadre@cap.gov (role=cadre) correctly receives 403 with the spec'd message on /settings, /dashboard, /scores GET and PUT.
_compute_total_percent ignores non-numeric field values silently — a malformed payload (e.g. {q1: 'one'}) would compute 0/9 silently. Consider validating type. Low priority.
/api/inspections/scores GET has no pagination beyond to_list(2000); fine for current scale but worth noting if data grows.
Legacy /api/points/* fully removed — all probed paths return 404 as expected.
seed_data_creation: Test rows created with cadet_participant_id prefix TEST_p1/p2/p3 and a module-scoped autouse cleanup fixture deletes Day 2/3 Alpha+Bravo inspection_scores and resets merit-points for Day 2 Alpha. Test settings are also restored to defaults after the validation test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inspections module fully passes backend. If retesting frontend, the relevant tabs to verify are Dashboard, Enter Scores, Weekly Totals, Settings on /inspections. Sidebar item should be hidden from role=cadre and direct URL navigation should show 'Access Restricted'. Test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_inspections.py and is safe to re-run (cleans up after itself).
